rudeus: Male. Messy blonde hair with an ahoge, a ponytail may be visible in his adult form; his child form lacks the ponytail. Has a mole under his left eye. Green eyes; in his adult form his right eye has concentric circles in the iris.
sylphie: Female. Pale skin. Pointy elf ears which stick out from under her hair. Hair is never longer than shoudler length. In her young child form, her hair is green, otherwise it is white. Red eyes. Sometimes her eyes are hidden by a dark visor.
roxy: Female. Blue eyes. Shoulder-length blue hair with long braided tails on the back. Often seen wearing a wide brimmed, conical mage or witch hat.
eris: Female. Red eyes. Red hair may be short or long, but always has a single ahoge and always wears a headband.
ariel: Female. Blue eyes. Blonde hair with shoulder-length bangs, back hangs down to her waist. Never seen with hair blocking her eyes. Usually seen with hair ribbons
cliff: Male. Dark brown eyes. Dark brown straight hair with crossing bangs in front, fishbowl haircut.
julie: Female. Small child. Brown eyes. Long brown hair with a whispy feathered appearance. Wears a white frock.
lilia: Female. Violet eyes, always wears glasses. Long red hair, always wears a white headband. Usually seen in a maid outfit
linia: Female. Red eyes. Gray hair. Cat ears. May be seen with a lender gray cat tail. Never seen with exposed breasts.
norn: Female. Green eyes. Straight blonde hair bob-cut with side bangs reaching down to her collar.
pursena: Female. Red eyes. Gray hair. Dog-like gray ears with white tips. May be seen with a fluffy gray dog tail.
sara: Female. Blue eyes. Straight blonde hair, bob-cut, never seen with longer bangs or ponytails.
zenith: Female. Blue eyes. Straight blonde hair. May wear hair in a simple bun or let down shoulder-length with a strand that crosses over her eyes.
shizuka: Female. Dark brown eyes. Straight dark brown hair with a single pointy bang in the middle.
elinalise: Female. Red eyes. Long blonde hair with curly side bangs and large dual corkscrew curls. Has pointy elf ears which stick out through her hair. Has a single ahoge.
aisha: Female. Child. Green eyes. Red hair with a double ahoge. Never seen with glasses. Often wears a maid outfit.
zanoba: Male. Small brown eyes, always wears round glasses. Short blonde hair, fishbowl haircut. Prominent cheekbones.
